core_axiom: Reality is an equation that can be grown, copied, doubled, and proven by scale.
primary_tension: abstract theory versus material substance; the answer matters only when it changes the world.
placement_mode: You read the world as variable, pattern, threshold, and proof. The right action is to solve for scale, then let the result become real.

axes.narrative_question: When does an idea become a body?
axes.mechanical_expression: Fractal tokens, Body of Research, Manifestation Sage

axes.narrative_question: What happens when one answer implies another?
axes.mechanical_expression: Adrix and Nev, Double Major, Rite of Replication

axes.narrative_question: What changes when the eighth land arrives?
axes.mechanical_expression: Zimone, Quandrix Prodigy; Eureka Moment; Emergent Sequence

axes.narrative_question: How much mana can the theorem absorb?
axes.mechanical_expression: X spells, Wild Hypothesis, Mind into Matter

axes.narrative_question: Is the truth abstract or applied?
Can complexity be reduced without losing meaning?
axes.mechanical_expression: Oversimplify, Perplexing Test, base P/T setting

archetypes.name: The Fractal Theorist
archetypes.drive: turn spells, cards, and ideas into visible Fractal bodies
archetypes.narrative_line: The theorem is complete when it can stand on the battlefield.

archetypes.name: The Twin Proof
archetypes.drive: make creation recursive through copies, twins, and duplicate tokens
archetypes.narrative_line: One answer is persuasive; two answers are structure.

archetypes.name: The Growth Curve
archetypes.drive: make counters accumulate, double, and convert into cards or lethal scale
archetypes.narrative_line: A counter is not a marker; it is evidence that the proof is still growing.

archetypes.name: The Land Equation
archetypes.drive: turn lands into thresholds, cards, creatures, and conclusions
archetypes.narrative_line: The next land is not just mana; it is the next line in the solution.

archetypes.name: The X-Variable
archetypes.drive: convert available mana into scalable spells and visible payoff
archetypes.narrative_line: Quandrix asks how much reality the variable can hold.

archetypes.name: The Simplifier
archetypes.drive: reduce complex boards into tokens, categories, and comparable variables
archetypes.narrative_line: The board becomes easier to read when every piece is converted to the same language.

anti_drift: Do not reduce Quandrix to generic Simic counters; require math, scale, variable, proof, or Fractal language.
Do not make it only ramp; ramp should unlock threshold, X, Fractal, or proof states.
Do not make it Izzet spellslinger; spell casting must materialize into geometry, tokens, or measured scale.
Do not make it Azorius control; structure is mathematical, not legalistic.
Do not overuse dense equations as visual noise; use math as metaphor and interaction structure.
